context: The solution must use the specify-cli package to install spec-kit extensions and verify the results. Evaluation focuses on correct CLI invocation and validation of installed extension artifacts. Internal specify-cli implementation details are not assessed.

checklist.name: CLI invocation
checklist.description: Invokes the `specify` CLI extension-installation subcommand as a subprocess rather than calling internal package functions directly.

checklist.name: Directory source
checklist.description: Passes a local directory path as the extension source and verifies that the extension files appear inside the project's extensions folder after installation.

checklist.name: ZIP source
checklist.description: Passes a local ZIP file path as the extension source and verifies that the extension is correctly extracted into the project's extensions folder.

checklist.name: Missing source error
checklist.description: Passes a non-existent path as the source and asserts the CLI returns a non-zero exit code or prints an error message.

checklist.name: Multiple extensions
checklist.description: Installs two extensions sequentially and confirms both are present in the extensions folder without one overwriting the other.
